entries.text: Heemeni! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mukana mumwe watapihwa zvakare kuswedera pedyo naMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari vanopa makomborero! [Congregation says, “Amen!”] Mwari vanoponesa asthma, [Congregation says, “Amen!”] TB! [Congregation says, “Amen!”] Mukondombera! [Congregation says, “Amen!”] Stroke! [Congregation says, “Amen!”] Headache! [Congregation says, “Amen!”] Vari pano Mwari ivavo. [Congregation says, “Amen/Yes Lord!”] Mwari vemunana! [Congregation says, “Amen!”]

entries.text: Mwari vechizaruro! [Congregation says, “Amen!”] Mwari vebarika! [Congregation says, “Amen!”] Vari pano manheru anhasi! entries.text: Mwari vaAbrahama. [Congregation says, “Amen,”] Mwari vaMozisi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari vaJakobho. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinokutendai nenyasha dzekufamba. entries.text: Chibatsirai Baba wakanaka vese vari kurwara. [Congregation says, “Amen,”] Vanonoka kubatsirwa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Variku…?...mbuka ne stroke Baba. entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Chiuyai mubatsire mumwe [Apostle claps his hands multiple times—ED] nemumwe ari mukati memba ino Tenzi wangu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda kubuda muno tichiti zvanga zvakanaka kuti tive muimba yaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chivai nevatsvena varikugadzirira August Britain ne America. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Isusuwo pano chitipaiwo gadziriro yakanaka. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinotenda ne gohwo Baba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinotenda nevakabatsirwa zvakanaka. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinotenda nevazvitakura iye zvino. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tenderai kuti mimba idzodzo dzisabve. [Congregation says, “Amen,”] nekuti makati, “ No barren in Israel.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vasina vana vapei. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinotenda negohwo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba makanaka kune vanokudai. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Zvinhu zvese zvinofamba mukanaka kune vanokunamatai. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Satani come out. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] In the Name of Jesus. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] I bind you right away! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tadza kuwana chaunoita mukati memba yaMwari. Baba chibatsirai muyenzi mumwe ne mumwe auya pakati pedu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Awane nyasha mukati memaoko enyu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Tinokutendai Baba wakanaka kuva mukati memba ino. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chitiparidzirai imimi manheru ano, [Congregation says, “Amen.”] taikumbira izvi Ishe wekururama nekutenda. Chitichengeterai kwatafuratira kwose, [Congregation says, “Amen.”] muZita raTenzi Jeso Kristu, Amen and Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tigare tese pasi.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: ….. muZita Tenzi Jeso Kristu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tafara zvakare kusanganiswa, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] zuva ranhasi muimba yaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hazvisi nyore , inyasha dzani…? [Congregation says, “dzaMwari,”] dzaMwari. You might take it for granted coming every time and having services and going back. It’s not that easy. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari vanotiitira nyasha zuva rimwe nei…? [Congregation says, “nerimwe,”] nerimwe.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Totenda hama dzafamba zvakanaka. Tichitenda kuona Brother Tino after a long time. Vanogara kure vanotadza kuuya nguva zhinji, [Congregation says, “Amen.”] tine mufaro kuva navo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hama dzedu dze Botswana we are happy to seeing you all of you. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Then hama dzedu dzeJoni vakwanisa kuuya tinotenda nyasha chaizvo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari ngavakuitirei zvakanaka. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Mwari vanokoshesa Shoko ravo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Effort iyoyo yekuuya iyoyiyi, inoratidza kuti warikoshesa chai…? [Congregation says, “chaizvo,”] chaizvoo. Ha’maona? Neniwo ndakudzidza kukoshesa Shoko raMwari nekuda kwevamwe vano sacrifi-sawo [to sacrifice—ED] Ndandichitaura kuti ndaka ndakaneta for the past two- two weeks or so ndichinzwa kuti aah. Iyoyi weekend ino iyi ndandakaneta zvekufa chaizvo. Zvokuti dai kwanga kusiri kuti kuda Mwari nekuremekedza kuti ah vamwe vafamba ndingadei ndangoto haa Pastor Chuma torai imwe yanhasi, Brother Rusono torai imwe mangwana. Kuti ungo—ungo nyama dzibatane uzorore. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: But unongozvisimbisa kuti aihwa takavimbisa Mwari kuti gore rose. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Heemeni. Ichauya hayo nguva yatichatora marivhi chai…chaizvo. But iye zvino hatidi kuti titi kana zvinhu zvatinenge takakumbira pamberi paMwari zvikarega kuitika wowana chimwe chinokuudza kuti wakanga wakuita slake. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] I would never want that to be an excuse. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Saka tirikuti dai Mwari akatiitira nyasha. Tadzimara tauya hanti’maona?

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Saka unozviona kuti kunyangwe wakaneta ukada, Mwari vanoita nyasha. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hauterere nyama yakoba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Unozozviona wapokuti aihwa Mwari vane ngoni. Uchinyatsoona kuti aihwa nhau yakaoma iyi. But unozozviona kuti Mwari vane nyasha, handitika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vanopindira so…? [Congregation says, “somehow,”] somehow, hanti’maona? Saka kuuya ku Chuch it’s a thing that we should never underestimate. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Nehama dzose dzafamba kubva Bruwayo, tinotenda Mwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hama dzabva Harare, Kwekwe, Kadoma. Kwese kwabviwa, tinokudza Zita raMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Do not forsake the assembling’s of one another to…? [Congregation says, “together,”] as you see the day a…?” [Congregation says, “approaching .”] Hanti’maona? Vanhu ngavaungane vachinamata nguva dzo…? [Congregation says, “dzose,”] dzose, hanti’moona ? Izvozvi zvatirikuita izvozvizvi zvinesimba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zvine simba risingaite, hanti’maona? Saka mufaro wedu kuti tiri muimba yaMwari.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Tinotenda Mwari takawana gowo rakanaka funny. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Taitarisira hedu hundred ma—tonne, asi takazoita seventy-three tonnes. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Still seventy-three tonnes is not a Joke. [Congregation claps ululates, claps and says, “Amen.”]Saka hatina kuendera Mainga pasina. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Taifambira zviri…? [Congregation says, “zviripo,”] zviripo. We have seventy-three tonnes, and we thank God for those seventy-three tonnes. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: The Angel which redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads; and let my name be named on them, and the name of my father’s Abraham and Isaac; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Ende totenda Mwari because hapana chasiyana. Seventy-three tonnes idzodzo gore rakapera patakanga tine hundred ten, hundred and twenty. We couldn’t finish twenty-five, dze last chii…? [Congregation says, “year.”] So, if we have seventy-three this year, then twenty-five tonnes dze last year. That gives us ninety-eight. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Saka tadzokera futi pa hundred paya. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Yataingoda iyoyo Mwari aizviziva kuti zvamati munoda hundred ka dzimwe twenty-five munadzo kudha…?[Congregation says, “kudhara, Amen.” Apostle chuckles—ED] Saka tinotenda Mwari chaizvo ehe, tinotenada Mwari chaizvo. Ende mapimiro edu kana ariwo avaiita ma brother egore rakapera, it’s definitely more than seventy-three. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Kana vaiita mapekero ataiita last year but I think our— we were not there, and we don’t know how there were packing these brothers. Kana vainyatsoti saga chaa three mabaghidhi handitika, maiisa mabhanghindi matatu pasaga rimwe chete handiti? Vaivepo? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndozvamaiita? Saka you were putting more than fifty kg’s handitika? Kureva kuti generally we are over a hundred slightly, slightly . Ndozvazviri nguva dzo…? [Congregation says, “dzose .”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Saka isu tinopima manje, tinotora masaga. Rinenge richifanira kuti ripinde two and half buckets. Isu tinoisa mangani…? [Congregation says, “three.”] three, ndo seventy-three tonnes yedu. Ukanzwa tichiti tawana hundred it’s more. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tikawana seventy-three tonnes it will—it’s definitely…? [Congregation says, “more.”] Over eighty. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Dzinenge dzirimo imo…? [Congregation says, “imomo,”] imomo plus last year twenty-five. Which is not really twenty-five, futi futi dze dziri more. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Saka ngatipei kutenda kuna Mwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinotenda chai…? [Congregation says, “chaizvo,”] chaizvo hanti’moona ehe? Mwari vakaita nyasha. Saka still if we decide to sell some which will tinokwanisa kutenga futi mbeu yedu yegore rino nedhiziri redu nefetiraiza yedu from our last year’s har…? [Congregation says, “harvest,”] harvest. Which is wonderful. Tobhadharawo magetsi a few dates here and… here and there. I will not be able to thank God with my mouth. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] The Lord has been indeed gra…? [Congregation says, “gracious.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Ranga riri gore rakanaka chai…? [Congregation says, “chaizvo,”] chaizvo. Now let’s start praying for next season. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Next season yangosarirwa ne three months. August, September, October, November tinenge takungodyara. We only have three months, ha’maona? For the next eeh season Saka haaa tiri kutarisira chai…? [Congregation says, “chaizvo.”] Gore rino takawana planter nyowani. Tikawana muromo wegejo munyowani watakatenga.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Saka marimiro acho achatipfuurei gore raka—rakapera. Ende tirikutarisa kuti tikatanga kunamatira mvura nekuti ndiko kurarama kwedu. Mwari anotiropafadza kubudikidza nemuzvirimwa, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] nemuzvipfuwo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Heemeni [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Takawona pa last week’s message yedu, murume akanga ainee hwai seven thou…? [Congregation says, “seven thousand.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Hanti’ takamuona murume aive me hwai seven thousand. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndiani murume uyu? [Congregation says, “Job.”] Kureva kuti Jobho waigona kudya hwai imwe chete pazu…? [Congregation says, “pazuva .”] Akasazvi filler, nokuti seven thousand ka unongotora tochingoti four hundred dzawatora pagore panosara eeh six thousand. [Congregation says, “six hundred,”] six hundred. Tochingoti pa six hundred chete ndodzobereka gore iroro. Seven thousand dzovhara dzese. Hanti’moona kuti dzadzokera futi pa seven thousand. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] But munofunga kuti kuti aiti akauraya four hundred pagore iroro pobereka three thousand. Hazvina [Apostle claps once—ED] zvazvachinja. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vaitokwikwidzana nekudzidya, but hapana zvavaidii….? [Congregation says, “zvavaiita.”] Mombe anga aine five hundred mombe, manje a family of Job which was ten people vanga vari ten handiti? He had seven sons and three daughters ndizvoka? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Then ivo varimukadzi nemui… nemurume then ne household.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Vakauraya mombe yaichovha zvisingadii…? [Congregation says, “zvisingaite.”] Vakadonhedza one mombe, two weeks vainayo. Zvino vaibva vati mombe voti hwai aaah pamwe nengarikuni pamuso…? [Congregation says, “pamusoro.”] Vanhu vainzi vakapfuma kare—kare vaipfuma nezvipfuwo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndopfuma chai…? [Congregation says, “chaiyo.”] Now we have learnt that when you saw the dollar become ba… bankrupt Zimbabwe became bankrupt and the dollar became moneyless, valueless, until un—noona Beira Cheque rakadonhera apa anodi…? [Congregation says, “anorinonga.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: But mbudzi panguva iyoyo pane musi unomuka mbudzi isina value? [Bother laughs and says, “hayaya kana,” congregation laughs—ED] Muri kuzvionaka kuti pfuma inoramba iri yakanzi naMwari ndiyo chii…? [Congregation says, “pfuma.”] Tingaita Amen here ipapo? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe mombe haimuke kuseni ichinzi nhasi mombe haisisina basa. Hapana pamunoti mombe ingashaya munhu anoiba. Mombe inogara yakadaro, but Bheira Cheque rakashaya munhu akarinhonga mu road. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Iyezvino unovhura drawer so yakazara nema Bheira cheque hapana kana one anoribata mumba mangu. [Apostle claps his hands five times—ED] But pane piece yenyama vanotora. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Saka pfuma taiziva. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tirikuti dai Mwari akatiitira nyasha, tikaziva izvozvo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mumwe nemumwe wedu akakwanisa kuti ane mhuri yake uwane ka portion kaunoita huku, ka portion kaunoita mbudzi, ka portion kaunoita mangarikuni, ka portion kaunoita nyama—huku dzemazai pfuma chaiyo chaiyo i huku dziripa yard, mbudzi kwete mari iri ku bank.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Takadzidza kuti unomuka kuseni mari iyoyo isisareve chii…? [Congregation says, “chinhu.”] Unomuka ku bank zvonzi mari yako haichareva chinhu. “Ndine one trillion.” Zvonzi, “Ehe one trillion iyoyo haitengi kana imba.” “Saka mati ndodyei” Voti, “Hameno.”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: But kana une kumusha kune mbudzi unodii… ? [Congregation says, “unoenda .”] Wonodimbura humbudzi yenyu musoro. Saka vanepfuma vanhu vanezvipfuwo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vane pfuma vanhu vane zvirimwa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Takapihwa zvisingaite naMwari gore rino. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Moona? Ndosaka ngatitendei chaizvo. Tiende mberi nekuramba tichinyengetera kuti Mwari tiitirei nyasha,hanti’moona?

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Then toda kuratidza chinhu one zuva ranhasi uno service yedu yanhasi. It’s the same thing that we will be talking about but tichingo tryer kutora ma angles akawanda kuti kunzwisisa kwako kukure. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda kutaura about a Father’s Right, ma rights aba… ababa. A Father’s Right, Father’s Rights or a Father’s Right hm. Now with that in mind, ndoda kuti munhu wese azive heritage yevanhu vaMwari. Nhaka yevanhu vaMwari kuti ko, nhaka yevanhu vaMwari chiiko? Heritage yavo, tetichingobata hedu maGwaro apo nepapo tichibata maGwaro apo nepapo, tichibata maGwaro apo nepapo. But pfungwa yangu yandinayo tetichida kuita summary yezvatinenge tambogoverena nevamwe Svondo iyi kuti uite picture yezvatirikudya tese. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Mukaona ha’moona, munhu wese panyika akauya panyika anoda chinhu one, kugara zvakadii…? [Congregation says, “zvakanaka.”] Ndochinangwa chekunamata, ndoda Ameni ipapa kahama, [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chinangwa chekunamata kugara zvakadii…? [Congregation says, “zvakanaka.”] Hatitaurei tose, chinangwa chekunamata…? [Congregation says, “chinangwa chekunamata,”] kugara zvakadii…? [Congregation says, “kugara zvakanaka,”] imba yakanaka…? [Congregation says, “imba yakanaka,”] mota yakanaka…? [Congregation says, “mota yakanaka,”] hembe dzakanaka…? [Congregation says, “hembe dzakanaka,”] chikafu chakanaka…? [Congregation says, “chikafu chakanaka,”] hutano…? [Congregation says, “hutano,”] furniture…? [Congregation says, “furniture,”] mhuri hombe…? [Congregation says, “mhuri hombe.”] Ndozvatinonamatira… ? [Congregation says, “ndozvatinonamatira,”] pasi pano…? [Congregation says, “pasi pano,”] kana izvozvo zvapfuura zvepasi pano…? [Congregation says, “kana izvozvo zvapfuura zvepasi pano,”] hupenyu husingapere…? [Congregation says, “hupenyu husingapere.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Tinganzwa Ameni here ipapa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ha’moona zvatinouyira ku Church, saka ukanzwa munhu achiti nganditambure, haazive zvaari kunamatira. Ndozvandaiyedza kuratidza kuti Mwari vakagara vati vanhu vanondinamata ndichakupai zvamunoda me…? [Congregation says, “mese,”] mese. Ndosaka muchiona ndichifarira nziyo yevana kuti, Nezuva iro tichaziva Mwari kana tose taropafadzwa. Nezuva iro tichaziva Mwari kana tose takomborerwa

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Saka hurombo inhaka yekunamata mudzimu. Hurombo inhaka yekusaziva ani…? [Congregation says, “Mwari.”] Vana vasinga teerere vana vakakudzwa kunzwe kwe Bhaibhiri. Mwari havamudii… havamuzive, vakakudzwa kunze kweBhaibhiri. Saka vana ava vanoteera tsika dzekunzvimbo dzavakurira.Vanemararamiro vakakopa muma rokisheni, avakakopa muma village. Asi mwa…munhu…mwana wemunhu waMwari haakope mararamiro anoitwa muma raini. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwana wemunhu waMwari anokopa mararamiro aanodzidziswa nababa vake. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handisi kunzwa Ameni ipapo hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Ende vana vedu havasi vekutaurira kuti Mwari akadai, it’s very difficult now the world is chao—chaotic very chaotic. You can’t go, woyenda wonoudza mwana wako kuti Mwari ndeuyu, Mwari ndeuyu havachateerera vana vedu. Vana vedu vakuda Mwari wavanoona. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Paive nekamwana kakanga kachitya mabhanan’ana husiku. Huh? Ndobva kwatibikira husiku manje mhenhi dzakurira pava pava pava, hova hova hova kamwana kabva katanga kuchema mhamha vacho ndobva vayenda ikoko zvikanzi, “Nyarara kani.”

entries.text: Vana babamukuru vachitaura. Takakura tichiudzwa izvozvo. VaMakwenya vaive nemudzimu, waityisa mudzimu wa’aMakwenya, waisika mhondoro. Mhondoro yainzi Nyamuzwa.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Haa! Takakura tichiudzwa zvese zveku—Ah! Mukanzi mugomo iro rinonzi Zumba iro, mune mapako aunoti ukapinda ikoko anenge achivhurika oga so. Achiti giba, achiti—mune mari imomomo, goridhe, mune… ah, mune hari dzizere negoridhe. And I grew up ndichiti one day ndichatakura gaba hwani chete. [Congregation laughs—ED]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Hanzi kana uchienda ikoko huswa hunenge huchivhurika hwega kudai, uchienda ikoko. Wosvika panenge paine kaburi kudai, moita kekuomberera kaburi kacho koti pfedu, wopinda imomo. entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Moona zvatakakura tichiudzwa? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] But ndaona rudzi rwedu kuKenzamba uko, ndinogara ndichirikoka, ndinozviona. Kana mabako iwayo zviri’zvo zvaanogona kuita ikoko uku, ngaagare akadaro mapako iwayo. [Congregation laughs—ED] Handidi kuaona futi mapako iwayo muhupenyu hwangu, ehe. Mapako akaipa chai...? entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: But kubva zvandakaziva Jeso, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] mufaro wandinawo uyu ndewani uyu...? [Congregation says, “ndewa Jesu.”] Hausisiri wedzinza rekwandakabva. entries.text: Mwari akandipa vana twenty-three, Mwari atipa gohwo re seventy-three, Mwari anotifambisa every weekend, up and down. Every weekend tiri pa road. entries.text: Zuva rimwe nei...? [Congregation says, “nerimwe,”] nerimwe. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hallelujah. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] But enda kuhama dzako uone.

entries.text: “Mateere nzeve iyi, haisi kunzva izvozvi, hainzve.”

entries.text: Vanotaura zvinonyadzisira. “Mateere ndakanyisiwa nzeve iyi. Kunyisiwa nezvinhu zviya izvi.” [Apostle and Congregation laugh—ED] Ndopandakaona kuti... entries.text: Ndakaona baba—hama dzangu dzichipinda mun’anga, ndakaona hama dzangu dzichirova makuva, ndakaona hama dzangu dzichiita mabira, dzichipira mudzimu, vachipera kufa munhu one, one nemukondombera. entries.text: Ende vakadzi vangu vanenge vanhu kwavo. Haisi type inobuda ichimhanya mhanya kuenda chero kwayaenda, vanozvichengeta. Vanhu vane tsika dzakana...? [Congregation says, “dzakanaka.”] Havazi vanongoti gii negotsi nemuhu wese wese in ten minutes time. Havana kudaro, handi’moona.

entries.text: Ndosaka munhu waMwari, hanzi masvika ipapo pacho pandinenge ndakaisa Zita rangu ipapo, ndopandakasvika kaini, ndo Message. Kwangu, anozotaura kuti, ‘Hindava?’ There will be no man, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] anoti ini ndakakuteverai but hapana zvamakandiiti…?”[Congregation says, “zvamakandiitira.”] “No man! There will no man.” who can say such a statement.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Saka vari kuti, “Ini ndakanamata ten years, but hapana zvandiinazvo?” Zvigunwe zvako zviri kukunongedzera iwe pacha…? [Congregation says, “pachako.”] You are a hypocrite. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tingaita Amen here varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Ino inguva yekusunungura vanhu kumweya yemadzinza. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Inguva yekusunungura vanhu kumweya yehuro…? [Congregation says, “yehurombo.”] Inguva yekusunungura vanhu ku fear! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Inguva yekunyatsoziva zvatakadanwa naMwari kuti tive tinogara nhaka mazvii…? [Congregation says, “mazviri.”] The heritage of the children of God! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Nhaka yedu chai…? [Congregation says, “chaiyo.”] Tingaita Amen here varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Iyo ndiyo nhaka yedu iyo. Ndiyo nhaka yedu iyo iya, ndonhaka yedu iyoyo. Takadanwa kuzoropafadzwa saAbrahama, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] saJakobho, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] semaJuta, vana veIsiraeri. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Imi ma Gentiles mauyawo mukunamata, ropafadzwaiwo! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Kwete kungoboira maziso muchechi pasina chinoitika. Heh? Ropafadzo revazhinji kuroorwa kana kuroora. Zvino munozogova… munozogocha mbeva here imomo kana maroorana? Mofanira kuuyawo kuChechi nemotaka? Vana vanoda kuendawo kuchikoro chakana…? [Congregation says, “chakanaka.”] Vanoda kupfekawo hembe dzakana…? [Congregation says, “dzakanaka.”] Vanodawo winter clothing ka varanda vaMwari?

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Imi baba hamufaniri kugara muchirwara-rwara. Eh, regai kuprovhoka [do not provoke—ED] vana venyu nokuda kwekutadza kuvariritira. Regai kuti vashore Message, nekuda kwe behaviour dzevabere…? [Congregation says, “dzevabereki.”] Vachiona mumba muchigochewa mbeva nguva nenguva, muchidyiwa mhandire.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Woenda kuimba yaKombai wosvika kuchifraiwa [to fry—ED] sausage. Vouya kwababa vavo, vanodya nemutetenerwa. Voenda kwaKombai, kune hwayi yechikwambo. Vana vodii ava? Vana vangani vanogona kuita withstand a father ane pfuma yake yemushonga? Anopedzisira aita give in nekuda kwenhamo handiti? Otora zvinhu zvababa zviye zvavakashanda zviya.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: But iwewe, rongera mhuri yako zvinhu zvakanaka. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vana vemunhu kwaye havasari vachibata zvikwambo nekuti havana kwavakazvidzidza. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Havana kwavakazviona zvichidii…? [Apostle and Congregation say, “zvichiitwa.”] Vanosara vachibata vaya; nhamo! Aone anotenga… ari kugara muka one room. Kamubhedha katataura kano dhirikira pakati. Anobikira mugabha, anomwira tea mugaba. Heh? Akati, “Hah!” N’anga ikati, “Tora apo, unozoitawo imba yako, nemunda wako, wonokohwa.”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Heh? Vanhu vakaenda divisi rokuchekeresa vana, kuremadza vana; kuti akohwe one tonne. Chikochikari chemadhongi chichienda kudai, vanhu vachiwokera. [Congregation laughs—ED]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: But kune vanoziva Jehovha! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari ha’a kuti ita divisi rekuku—rekutora zvikochikari ten kuita one tonne. Kuuraira vanhu one tonne? Hamuna kuona vanhu vachu-chekeresera vanhu chi hot dhogi chepanze apapapa? Ha’moona zvi hot dog zvamunoona izvi zviya? Vanochekeresaka ipo paya kuti atengerwe masa—masamba iwaya.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Zvinorarira vamwe vakasvunura, Mwari anokupa uvete! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “My peace I give unto…?” [Congregation says, “unto you.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatichinzwai apa. Verse 29 tese, hativerengei verse 29 tese. Verse 29 tose. And Jesus answered and said, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for My sake, and the Gospel's, But he shall receive an hundredfold now in this time,

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Hatimirirei ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hanzi, “He will receive what…?” [Congregation says, ‘a hundred fold,’] when…? [Congregation says, ‘now,’] in this what…?” [Congregation says, “time: Amen.”; Apostle Gumbura chuckles—ED] When I saw that Scripture, It excited me so much, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] kuti Jesus actually said it. Kuti, “Hakuna munhu akasiya, hupenyu hwepasi pano, nekuda Kwangu, nekuda kweVhangeri Iri; anofanira kutambira a hundred what…?” [Congregation says, “fold.”] Hanzi, “Panguva ipi…?” [Congregation says, “now/ino; Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndiani vaya vanoda kutinyepera kuti pakunamata kwemu Tu… Testamendi ndezvomweya? Ndozvomweya zvima… Zvanzi, “…houses…” naJeso? Vati houses? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vati wife here futi? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hanzi, “Ukatiziwa ne wife unorisivha chii…?” [Congregation says, “hundred fold.”; Apostle Gumbura chuckles—ED. Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen!”] Toda Amen akadarika Amen hama! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Dzimba unoita hundred kana ukaruza imwe che…? [Congregation says, “imwe chete.”] Mota ukaruza hwani uchaita dzimwe hundre…? [Congregation says, “hundred.”] Ndokunge wairuzira Vhange…? [Congregation says, “Vhangeri; Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Hanzi, “Kana kune akaruza imba, kana kune akaruza mota, kana kune akaruza mukadzi, kana kune akaruza vana, nekuda kweVhangeri, nekuda kweZita Rangu; uchawana times hundred!” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatiite Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Hallelujah!”] Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Hallelujah.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Heh? Murikuona Shoko raMwari, kuti harinyepe? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hanzi, “…you will receive it,” usati wa…? Wafa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kwete kuti, “Ini hangu ndichadya doma—madora. Inini ndiri pasi pano, ndichadya zvangu derere, zvose ndichadya kana nemunyu, nekuda kwaJeso wangu.”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: “Ah! Ah! Ah! Ah! Ah! Ah-ah! Iwe! Iwe! Thula wena, thula, thula, thula, thula, thula. [Congregation laughs—ED] Kanti wena uyazi mm, [Congregation laughs—ED] kuti ukhukhuluma? Uri kukhukhuluma ndaba zonhema zoga zoga.” [Congregation and Apostle Gumbura laughs—ED]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Uri kunyepa iwe, handi’moona, eh? Hakuna zvakafanana nayi…? [Congregation says, “naizvozvo.”] Eh. Mwari ukava—uka… Mombe yako chaiyo chaiyo, ukaisacrifaiza [if you sacrifice—ED] kuna Jehovha. Dzinofanira kudzoka dziri ngaani mombe idzi? [Congregation says, “hundred fold.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Masofa ako akaparara achigarwa nevatsvene, anofana kudzoka ava ma sets mangani? [Congregation says, “ hundred fold; Amen.”] “…Let every man be a liar! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] And God’s Word be what…?” [Apostle Gumbura and Congregation say, “true.”; Congregation says, “ Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndosaka isu takati tichipihwa naMwari, takatora ma 504, ma Bluebird. Tikapa vana Andrew. Tikapa vana Marisa motikari idzi, vakadzisakadza, vakadzichembedza. But tinombozviziva kuti kwakaitikei? Did God fulfil His Word? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Takavhura imba yedu yeku Ridgemondi iyo, sabhabha raityisa ku Ridgemondi iro, rikakanyiwa-kanyiwa. Rakanga rine si…Rine kitchen yesimbi, but vanhu vakakwachura simbi, kukwachura kudonhedza ku… nekuwanda. Ha’moona?

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Kuenda vapedza kukwachura simbi dzichidonha. Vaienda pama door acho, vachiita kupara pendi kudaiwo nemaoko avo. [Congregation laughs—ED] Pendi ye green kupera [Apostle Gumbura chuckles—ED] yose. Haah! Handisati ndakamboona zvakadaro. Matoireti ese ma seats aya kutyoka, kukwachuka. Tichiripresa [we replaced—ED] matoireti, kukwachuka. Ma carpets, kubvisa tichiisa mamwe! But Mwari akazoti wopa dzimba idzodzo dzodzoka zvino. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Masadza ese akanga achidyiwa mumba imomo, iye zvino nemuchato yese yatai…yana—yana brother vaya vaiti vachichata nhasi, mangwana vachitiza. Michato yese iya. Ndoma tonne aakudii aya…? [Congregation says, “a’akuuya; Amen.”] Nde’emunana, Jehovha ndeve munana! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Aaamen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Let every man be a lia…? [Congregation says, ‘a liar,'] and God’s Word be ye…?” [Congregation says, “true.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Saka munhu, ha’moona akawuya muno muzonamata orasikirwa kana nechikoro chaicho, God should be able to give you back what is more than educa…? [Congregation says, “education.”] Ukarasikirwa ne husband, God will replace. Ukarasikirwa ne wife, God will replace. Chawarasikirwa nacho uri mukunamata, Mwari vanodzorere…? [Congregation says, “vanodzoreredza.”] Ukarasikirwa nem—nemukadzi, nevana; Mwari achakupa vaka—vakadzi vevana. Ukarasikirwa nemurume, Mwari achakupa mumwe kana uri mukadzi, nevana futi hobho.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Kana wazviitira Vhangeri, “Rejoice in the Lord! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] And again I say re…?” [Congregation says, “rejoice; Amen.”] Brother ndakatenga furniture sebenzi. Imwe mibhedha ndichiisa mumba maVaWagusiwa. Imwe ndichiisa mumba maMarisa, imwe ndichiiisa mumba ma aKatewe, ndichiisa… Kutenga furniture sebenzi! Zvokuti payakapararaka, waichema kufunga kuti handichagona kuriplesa [to replace—ED] imwe. Iye zvino, vanhu handicha… ya… I realise that was no…? [Apostle Gumbura and Congregation say, “nothing.”; Congregation says, “Amen!”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Inini hapana chinhu changu chakandakaisa kubasa raMwari, Mwari chavasina kudzo…? [Congregation says, “kudzosa.”] Vana Brother vatakanamata navo vana Brother Chrispen Dombo, vese vana Brother vaya vaya, vakatibira magumbezi nezvitofu ku Bluffhill. But nhasi vakasvika pamba pangu, zvikwatara-kwatara zvezvinhu izvi, handitomboziva kuti zvakafa zvitofu zvingani, zvinogona kungot—swa tambo mbi… Kungodimurwa tambo negonzo ndasendeka. Ndakunotsvaga chimwe.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Kungotsva hot plate che… zvekuswera ndichinama hot place, ndichiisa madhaka hobho hobho, mukati handina nguva iyoyo. [Congregation laughs—ED] Ndinonobura chinyo…? [Congregation says, “chinyowani.”] A hundred fold! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndofunga ndikanyora pasi zvitofu zvandakatenga panyika pano kana iwewe, unoshokekana [you will be shocked—ED] iwe. Ndaingopinda ndoti, chinyowani, chakutodzoka kumba. Chinyowani, chino—zvitofu mafriji. [refrigerators—ED] Mamwe takapa vakahedhuka vakaenda nawo. Iye zvino havasisina fridge dzakafa idzodzo.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: But ini ndakasara ndichiona dzi…? [Congregation says, “dzimwe.”] “…et every man be a liar!” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndosaka Mwari wandinonamata vanhu vaMwari, ndiMwari wemunana. Ukaenda kuMaenga neku Hilltop unozviona. Ukaudzwa history ya 2000, unozviona. Ukaona vana vechikoro vakauya pano vachiqualifaya [qualifying—ED] vari vana vezvikoro, zvavave nhasi, unozviona. Ukaona nyasha dzekufamba, “…Your going out and your coming in,…” unozviona. Ukauya muChechi medu ukaona Mweya urimo, unozviona. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Wudzai vana venyu! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zvinhu izvo…? [Congregation says, “izvozvo.”] Vataurirei vana venyu zvinhu izvozvo. Hanzi, “…Panyika pano unowana dzimba, motokari vakadzi, zvose vana, everything.” But after wafa, Hupenyu husingadii…? [Congregation says, “Husingaperi.”] That’s what that Scripture says. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Saka imimi chiendai munoudza vana vako.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Vana vako unenge uchavataurira kuti, “Mwanangu, ndiMwari akatibatsira pana 2000. NdiMwari akatipa Maenga. NdiMwari akatipa Hilltop. NdiMwari aunza shumiro iyoyo yaungana vanhu vaMwari ava. Ukaona mukomana uyo, akauya akadai, akadai, akadai. Iye zvino wava munhu mukuru chaizvo. Akauya asina chinhu ipo paya. Uyu akauya achangopedza chikoro musikana uyu. Akanga akashata kudaiwo, usashamisike nezvaave izvo, aporishiwa neMweya Mutsvene. [Congregation laughs—ED] Uyo anga akadai…”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Unenge uchimuudza history yemunhu wese ari ipa…? [Congregation says, “ari ipapo.”] Tichitaura manana aJehovha! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ende te’tichireva nhema here? Te’chireva chokwadi.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Kuti, “Uri kuona Caro uyo, akuuya ari kasikana kanozwisa tsitsi kanga kapupurirwa naRudo but iye zvino tarirawo atopedza course yake ari pabasa, eh. Uri kuona Lolo uyo, takamutora kuma yard ekurukisheni yeku Mkobha. Ndokwaaishanda but ezvino honai ava nurse uyu, eh. Hona Tanatsirwa uyo, wakanga achinetswa nemadzisekuru ku-kunhingi uku, kumusha uko. Iye zvino vakamuona murungu wavo uyo nhasi uyo. Hona Luckson uyo, akauya, aingogara ari kamupfanha kadiki, nhereraka but tarira zvaaitigwa.”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Unenge uchitaura hwani, hwani. Woti, “Ah! Uri kuona mupfanha uyo anonzi Keith uyo. Waipenda tupu—papepa rakaki. Achipenda pama cardboard box mupfanha uyu. Iye zvino, waakurova canvas. Ukuona, ahh Welly uyu, waifamba netsoka uyu, anga ari mukaradhi wekwaChiundura uyo. Achiuya panapa achita te… pa Technical College.” [Congregation laughs—ED] Ahh! Unovapedza vese hwani hwani kudaiwo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: But mugore iroro tichaziva Mwari nekuti tese tinenge taropafadzwa! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] NdiMwari wemina…? [Congregation says, “weminana.”] What happened to a... to your master should happen to every disci…? [Congregation says, “disciple.”] Handi’maona? Saka, zvinotofanira kuitika kwauri. That… ndokunge mwoyo wako waroohwa nekutenda. Ndokunge wajekerwa, ndokunge warega kufurirwa nevanokusejusayi, [those who seduce—ED] nevanoda kukubvisai mu path yechokunamata.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Woramba wakabata nemaoko maviri. Rega kuzunguzwa, rega kubviswa. Follow those Commandments. You heard Abraham, achiropafadzwa. You heard Jacob, achiropafadzwa. You heard Moses, achi- exhorta [exhorting—ED] vana veIziraeri. Then you heard Jesus achitaura zvinhu zvimwe chete. “At the mouth of two or three witnesses, let everything be esta…?” [Congregation says, “established.”] Let everything be taught as a do…? [Congregation says, “doctrine.”] Tingaita Amen here varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika ipapo hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: I-Shoko raMwari rechokwadi iri, hapana kana exaggeration. NdoShoko raMwari chairo, chai…? [Congregation says, “chairo.”] Chidzokera unotanga kutaura, “Pandakauya paChechi…” Brother ava, ndozvavanenge vakutaura, Brother Magunde.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: “Unoziva Crysta, ndakauya paChechi ipo paya paya, ndichingori kamupfanha kanobva ku—ku—ku kuMagunje uku. Heh? Ndandakudzwa na step mother. Ndakakura ndichirarama hupenyu hwakaoma fani but tarira zvandakitirwa naMwari. Ndakazobva ipapapa pashumiro [02:37:34.2-inaudible] tiri pasi peshumiro iyoyo tikaenda Botswana. Hah, ndopatakazovaka imba iyo. Ndakatenga mota ikokoko. Ehe, munin’ina wako uyo anga asati azvarwa nguva iyoyoyo. Mwari watinonamata uyo.”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Vanenge vachidraivha [they will be driving—ED] Benz yavo, vachiuya havo kuchechi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Heh? Vachiisa nziyo yaJoze. Nezuva iro, ti…

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Dzimba hadzi… dzimbo hadzingoimbwi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zvinoitwa nevana vemapenzi izvozvo. [Congregation laughs—ED] Nziyo ngaive ne history handitika eh? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kwete kuti changouya chingoti, “Tindindindi, tindindindi… tindindindi… tindindi… tindi…” [Apostle Gumbura demonstrates and Congregation laughs—ED]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: U—Uri kuita chii? Uri kuti chii? Wakuto… Chakutekenyedza ipapo chii? Hamusati makamboona mapenzi mumabhawa umo. Anongobvinyinguka nezvinhu zvisina nebasa ro…? [Congregation says, “rose.”] Changorira chese chete. [Apostle Gumbura demonstrates the dance moves; Congregation laughs—ED]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: But vana veIsiraeri vaiimba Pisarema pamusoro peBhabhironi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vachirangarira kwavakabviswa naMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Iwewe nyatsorangarira nziyo yako iti, “Ah, takaparidzirwa nziyo iyi takaimbirwa nevana.”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Eh. Iye zvino Mwenga unenge wabatana manje, takunyatsoratidza simba reMwenga. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Zvonzi, “Takaimbirwa mwe—nziyo nekamwana kadiki-diki kainzi Tafadzwa, imi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Heh?? Kuti dai Mwenga wabata…?” [Congregation says, “wabatana.”] Eh, inonzi chii nziyo iya hanzii…? [A brother from the Congregation says, “Mwari Batanidzai Mwenga.”] Mwari batanidzai Mwenga, mwoyo yedu yaizofara. Mwari batanidzai Mwenga, chiporofita chaizozadzikiswa.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndakamuvhunza ndikati, “Iwe iwe, ndiani akakucompozera [composed for you—ED] nziyo iyi? Hauna kuudzwa na aChigova here?” Zvikanzi, “VaChigova vakatobvunzawo.” [Apostle Gumbura and Congregation laughs—ED] Ndakangoona ndi Brother Kudzai. Zvikanzi, “Brother Kudzai,” hanzi, “Vakatondivhunzawo kuti, ‘Iwe ma words aya apihwa nani?’”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Patakaabvunza muno, sekuru vake vakafunga kuti ndiani…? Ndi Esther, nekuti Esther ane yake ye fasting yekuti, “Batanidzai Mwenga.” Vakafunga kuti ndiye anyora iyoyo. But chimwana chiya chakanyora che…? [Congregation says, “chega.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Ukaona Mweya Mutsvene woenda kuzera riya iri, kureva kuti vana mai vari muno Mweya wapfuura. [Congregation laughs—ED] Wakaedza kupinda munana mai vakawanda, ukaona kuti, “Ah-ah, hamuna …?…” Ndobva waenda pawakanozorora zvawo, Mweya wacho uya. But ukaiona nziyo yacho haina zera nemwana uya. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Iya nziyo ndeye Mweya Mutsvene iya! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Aaamen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] I rebuke kune vasinganamate Mwari muMweya nemui…? [Congregation says, “nemuzvokwadi.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndosaka isusu manje ngatichikumbirai ropafadzo iri. Toda ropafadzo. Chinangwa chatirikudira ropafadzo nechekuti, “Baba, ndiro simba ratinoita pamusoro pevana vedu.”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Mwana anenge achirwirawo kuti asiirwe imba, asiirwe business, asiirwe motokari, nekudaro anoteerera zvaanoudzwa nababa vaani…? [Congregation say, “vake,”] vake. Anenge achiona baba vake kuti vakagona, hupenyu hwavo achikompeya [comparing—ED] vamwe vana baba vemapenzi uko, oona kuti aah! Vake vakagona kumuwanira chikoro. Vakagona kumudyi—kumupfekedza. Vakagona kumupa chekudya.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Saka at least anoteere…? [Congregation says, “anoteerera,”] anoteerera. Saka unogona kuchimuudza kuti, “Mwanangu chiita zvakati. [Congregation says, ‘Gospel.’] Let him be a…?” [Congregation says, “accursed.”] He knew kuti possibility yekudzokera kumasure iri..? [Congregation says, “iripo.”] iripo. Saka meka shuwa kuti unonyatsoona Mwari waunowona. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Mwari [Apostle Gumbura claps once—ED] vakuitireyi nyasha chaizvo. Totanga service yedu mangwana na ten o’clock. Kuitira kuti tikurumidzewo kudii…? [Congregation says, “kupedza.”] kupedza. Mwari vakuitireyi nyasha chaizvo. Hatisimukeyi hedu tese. Hymn I35. “Oh Lord my God, when I’m in awesome wonder.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. Oh… Oh… O Lord my God! When I in awesome wonder. (Consider all) Consider all the worlds Thy hands have made; (I see the stars) I see the stars, (I hear) I hear the rolling thunder, (Thy pow’r throughout) Thy pow’r throughout the universe displayed. (Ho, Then sings my soul) Then sings my soul, my Saviour God to Thee; (How great Thou art) How great Thou art, (How great Thou art) How great Thou art! (Then sings my soul) Then sings my soul, my Saviour God to Thee; (How great Thou art) How great Thou art, how great Thou art! (When through the woods) When through the woods (Oh Lord) and forest glades I wander (And hear the birds) And hear the birds sing sweetly in the trees; (When I look down) When I look down (Oh Lord) from lofty mountain grandeur (And hear the brook) And hear the brook (Oh Lord) and feel the gentle breeze. (Oh, Then sings my soul) Then sings my soul, my Saviour God to Thee; (How great Thou art) How great Thou art, (How great Thou art) How great Thou art! (Then sings my soul) Then sings my soul, my Saviour God to Thee; (How great Thou art) How great Thou art, how great Thou art! (And when I think) And when I think (My Lord) that God, His Son not sparing. (Sent Him to die) Sent Him to die, (My Lord) I scarce can take it in; (That on the cross) That on the cross, (My bur…) my burden gladly bearing, (He bled died) He bled and died (To take) to take away my sin. (Then sings my soul) Then sings my soul, my Saviour God to Thee; (How great Thou art) How great Thou art, (How great Thou art) how great Thou art!
